description: This Java class 'SSLContextCreator' creates SSL contexts from connection credentials, supporting client certificates, trust managers, and hostname verification, with methods for different SSL configurations.

classes.name: SSLContextCreator
classes.description: A class that creates SSLContext objects based on connection credentials, supporting various SSL configurations including client certificates and trust managers.

methods.name: withTrustManager
methods.description: Creates an SSLContextCreator with a preconfigured TrustManager.

methods.name: fromConnection
methods.description: Creates an SSLContextCreator based on a Connection object, verifying certificates as specified.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an SSLContextCreator that verifies server identity with optional trusted certificates.

methods.name: clientCertificate
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext with client certificates.

methods.name: withoutClientCertificate
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext without client authentication.

methods.name: newTLSContext
methods.description: Initializes a new SSLContext with specified key and trust managers.
